newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Rugby union-All Blacks obliterate Argentina.
newsitem.headline: Rugby union-All Blacks obliterate Argentina.

text.p: New Zealand, in a brilliant handling display, obliterated Argentina 93-8 in the first rugby test at Athletic Park on Saturday.
Playing in perfect weather, the All Blacks played rugby to match, displaying a huge gulf between the professional home side and the largely amateur Pumas.
With the sun and wind at their backs the All Blacks ran in seven first half tries and, proving their professionalism, did not let up, running in another seven in the second half.
